description: Use this when a user asks what supplementary (top-up, complementary) health insurance costs per month on average, for a reference person such as someone aged 60, a single adult or a couple with children, in France (country FR). Returns the average monthly premium that the official survey of insurers publishes for that profile and contract type, the survey year, a confidence label, and the official source and licence. These are survey averages across insurers (no record count is published), not a personal quote, not a price list and not an amount one person paid. How fresh: biennial: the survey years 2019, 2021 and 2023 are published (newest 2023); each answer states its survey year. Do not use for compulsory basic health cover, for a personal quote, or for countries that are not listed.

contract.description: individual = bought by the person (default); group = employer-arranged cover. France: individual (default) or group (employer-arranged). Ages are published for individual contracts only.

country.description: FR = France (DREES survey of insurers: average monthly premium of supplementary 'mutuelle' cover, EUR, survey years 2019, 2021 and 2023)

profile.description: Reference person, see the country notes, e.g. 'age 60', 'single', 'couple', 'couple 2 children', 'lowest income'. Default: single (the survey's reference insured). France: age 20 / 40 / 60 / 65 / 75 / 85 (individual contracts), single…

year.description: Survey year (the survey is run every two years). Default: the newest. France: survey year 2019, 2021 or 2023 (default: newest).

name: pricepaid_supplementary_health_insurance

outputSchema.description: Price range from real records: price, sample_size, period, confidence, source and licence.

summary.description: One sentence an AI can quote.

title: Supplementary health insurance premiums (published averages)
